description: Get a game's API keys. Returns, per key: kind ('public' | 'secret'), prefix, createdAt, and rotation/revocation timestamps. The PUBLIC key includes its full plaintext (it's safe to embed in client code). The SECRET key's plaintext is ALWAYS null over MCP — only its prefix is shown, for identification. Use this to retrieve the public key for a client_only integration, or to check which keys exist / have been revoked. If the developer needs the full SECRET key (for a client_with_server / server_only anti-cheat setup), direct them to https://dashboard.scorezilla.dev — the Keys section under their game — since it never leaves the dashboard.

gameId.description: UUID of the game to fetch keys for (from list_games)

name: get_keys
